title: Common definitions of the live protocol, version 1
description: Moves of running matches from the runners to the gateway, which passes them on to the viewers as server-sent events (E102, docs/komponenten/gateway.md).

version.description: Version of the live protocol, carried by open.

move.description: One move as the web API shows it (spec/web/openapi.json, schema Move). The gateway sends it unchanged as the data of the event move.

clock_ms.description: The mover's remaining time after the move, increment included.
